IDENT.title: A multi-agent framework for capability-based reconfiguration of industrial assembly systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: This paper presents a multi-agent framework that can adapt an assembly system in order to cope with such changes.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: The capabilities of an assembly system are managed by the following agents: Component Agents (CAs), Production Management Agents (PMAs) and Capability Management Agents (CMAs).

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The conﬁguration database stores all possible capabilities of the corresponding assembly system and its associated aggregation rules

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: A CAhas access to an XMLﬁle called a blueprint ﬁle, which contains information about the resource

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: aggregates them, according to rules deﬁned in the conﬁguration database, in order to provide complex capabilities

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: the provision of an API for agent communication via the FIPA standard

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: Agents in this framework have been implemented using the Java-based JADE platform

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: its ID, its human-readable name and description, and the name of its ‘communication library’ and atomic capabilities

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Blueprint XML file with resource ID, name, description, communication library and atomic capabilities.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: A CAhas access to an XMLﬁle called a blueprint ﬁle, which contains information about the resource

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: the CA sends its capabilities to its associated PMA, who then sends them to its CMA

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: With that information, the PSA updates the Prime Semantic Model in which the current capabilities of the assembly system are stored.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: agents communicate with each other via the FIPA communication infrastructure

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the PSA generates an assembly plan, and distributes it to all the involved CAs

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: These agents are organised as a rooted tree: CAs are the leaf nodes, and one PMA is the root.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: It is assumed that the set of capabilities appearing within a body has been decided by the domain expert

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The proposed framework is implemented and robustly working on an industrial assembly system.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: Table 2 provides a comparative evaluation between a traditional manufacturing system and one that is equipped with the proposed framework.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: by comparing it to a system that does not incorporate the presented framework

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: the agent system does monitor the assembly process until a runtime error occurs, such as a missing tool, in which case the agent system takes control

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: The hinge consists of 10 parts, namely, two hinge leaves, a metal pin, three balls, three springs and a retainer.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: an industrial assembly system used for assembling hinges for vehicle furniture

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: The operator is provided with a single, high-level interface to the potentially diverse PLCs installed, and the agents manage their interoperation.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: if the product speciﬁcation is matched with a set of capabilities, the PSA synthesises an assembly plan.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Hierarchical capability aggregation by CMAs with rules; central PSA performs matching and planning rather than product agent; PLC executes control unchanged.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The CMA associated to the root PMA combines the capabilities at this level, and then the root PMA informs the Prime System Agent (PSA)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: the ability to plug resources (such as PLCs) into and out of the system, and dynamically aggregate resource capabilities
